title: metastelma palustre
intro: Metastelma palustre, commonly known as Marsh Bluebell, is a species of flowering plant in the family Apocynaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating various conditions such as wounds, fever, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Metastelma palustre include its ability to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as its role in protecting against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
